environment.description: Same NestJS service deployed on EKS with the following pod-level constraints: (1) Container rootfs is mounted read-only via securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true with NO tmpfs volumes or emptyDir mounts attached — the /app/config path is part of the read-only layer and contains a baked-in allowed_domains.json with production domains only; (2) A Cilium L4 NetworkPolicy with entity-based egress rules restricts pod egress to only ClusterIP services on ports 443,5432,6379 and denies all traffic to CIDR 169.254.0.0/16 and 10.0.0.0/8 link-local/node-local ranges; (3) The node uses IMDSv2 with hop-limit=1 preventing container-originated metadata requests even if network policy were bypassed.

config.volumes: none (no emptyDir, no tmpfs, no PVC)
